title: Nonvanishing conjecture for projective log canonical pairs
exact_target: Must a pseudo-effective log canonical divisor on a projective complex pair acquire a nonzero section after some positive integral multiple?

sources.citation: Houari Benammar Ammar, Remarks on the Direct Image Sheaf of Logarithmic Pluricanonical Bundles and the Non-Vanishing Conjecture, arXiv:2501.04232v1 (2025).
